topics.name: Atypical Vascular Lesion of the Irradiated Breast
topics.visual_anchor: Small pink/brown or erythematous papules/vesicles arising in irradiated breast skin.
topics.inclusion_rationale: Visible post-radiation skin lesion is an important differential of radiation-associated angiosarcoma; retain separately because benign atypical vascular lesion is not angiosarcoma.
